title: Entity change
responsibility: Explains a selected historical change with recorded reasons, review notes and before/after measurements.

inputs.name: EntityChange.row
inputs.description: Required history row with commit, subject/date, predecessor, measured size/complexity, changes and budget reviews. Earlier size/complexity are derived as current minus recorded delta only when both exist.

inputs.name: EntityChange.timings
inputs.description: Required measurements, one per profile/target, with before/after values and units. Missing before displays unmeasured and no delta; numeric delta is rounded to four decimal places.

inputs.name: EntityChange.detail
inputs.description: Required revision detail or null while reading. Distinguishes unavailable registry/impact from a known revision with no reasons.

inputs.name: EntityChange.nav
inputs.description: Required route/navigation context used to open this entity at the row’s commit. Both captured-state and comparison actions use that destination.

inputs.name: EntityChange.full
inputs.description: Optional bindable flag, false by default, controlling expansion of original reason text.

outputs.name: EntityChange
outputs.description: Selected-change panel with commit/date/subject, summarized behavior/simplification/performance reasons and original disclosures. Shows budget/baseline reviews with long notes expandable. Measurement table separates source size, complexity and profile timings and labels missing measurements explicitly.
